---
name: Bug report
about: Describe something in AGI that behaved unexpectedly.
---

For a security issue, use the [private reporting instructions](https://github.com/compoodment/agent-group-interface/security/policy).

What were you trying to do, and what happened instead?

What are the shortest steps to reproduce it?

Which AGI version are you using? Include your terminal and `$TERM` for screen
problems, or the agent client and its version for connection problems.

Include any relevant error text with private information removed. Use a
[disposable conversation](https://github.com/compoodment/agent-group-interface/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#report-a-problem)
for screenshots.
Keep your chat directory and backup archives private.
